Spring 1945

Suzie and Angela the Angel (12 pages)

Ginger Has Just Met Tommy Turner... (6 pages)

Suzie the Chorus Girl! (12 pages)

Little Miss Suzie (10 pages)

Summer 1945

Florida Beach Wear (6 pages) - In order to earn money to buy an expensive bathing suit, Suzie takes a job at the Ladies Fashion Boutique, but proves to be of little help to the store.

The Professor's Assistant (7 pages)- Suzie assists an eccentric inventor trying to market his impractical inventions.

Oh, What A Knight (9 pages)- Ferdie is hired to protect Mrs. Van Gelt's society party. Suzie tags along to make sure Ferdie doesn't make things worse, as Ferdie goes to the party disguised as a medieval knight.

A Day On The Town (6 pages) - After winning a pinup contest at a local department store, Katy and Sis go to claim her prize.

The Carpenter (8 pages) - Suzie and Ferdie are subcontracted to build a dog house for an ill-tempered bulldog.

Clothes Make The Man (7 pages) - Ferdie gets into an altercation with a brute over a suit of clothes. When the brute, who is a local boxing champ, is accidentally knocked unconscious, everyone assumes Ferdie did it and fixes him up with a rematch against the champ in the boxing ring.

Suzie Fashion Department (6 pages) - Suzie shows the Postman why she receives so much mail.

Oh What a Beautiful Morning (8 pages) - Suzie and her date participate on the Sudsy Wudsy Quiz program.

How's my form Ferdie? (6 pages) - Ferdie and his boss have a skiing accident.

Howdy, Suzie! (7 pages) - Suzie and Ferdie go to work on a dude ranch.

Happy Birthday Katy Keene (6 pages) - Sis gets a birthday present for Katy, but eats the whole thing before giving it to her.

Gee I Hope I Get That Job I Applied For! (8 pages) - Suzie poses for a comic book artist.

(1st appearance of Ferdie's rival Gregory)

February 1948

Surprise Party - Suzie (9 pages) Suzie is Joined by Archie and the Gang in throwing a surprise birthday party for Ferdie. [some pages include pin-ups with clothing designs for Suzie that were contributed by readers from around the U.S.]

1 page Suzie paper doll with outfits page

"Well which picture do you think is best Ferdie?" - Suzie (6 pages) Suzie asks Ferdie to look at pictures of her in various outfits and tell her what looks best, but Ferdie can't decide. [page one of the story has various pin-ups of Suzie]

Suzie's Puzzle page (1 page)

"I just tripped over this rug again!" - Suzie (6.5 pages) Suzie & Ferdie create disaster when they attempt to clean & put away a rolled up rug that her mom keeps tripping over.

Suzie's Hollywood quiz (1 page)

"The Team Looks Pretty Good..." - Ginger (6 pages) Ginger and Dotty are watching the football team practice when Dotty gets hit by a stray ball.

Suzie's Movie Diary (2 pages, text)

"That Leaky faucet..." - Suzie (4 pages) Suzie & Ferdie attempt to repair a leaky faucet.

Suzie Quiz (1 page)

Katy Keene the Pin-up Queen Story (8 pages) Katy has a photo shoot at the zoo and brings Sis along. [1st page of feature is a full page pin-up of Katy, last page has a Katy ad and a Katy paper doll and outfits.]

Contents:

Ferdie Muscles In (Suzie) - 6 pages

Horsefeathers (8 pages) [Suzie]

Train Ride (8 pages) [Suzie]

The Unwelcome Guest (5 pages) [Suzie]

December 1949

Come Into My Parlor - Suzie (6 pages)

Which Watch - Suzie (5 pages)

It's a Man's World - Suzie (8 pages)

High Flyer - Ginger (6.25 pages)

It's a Snap - Suzie (7 pages)

Katy Keene the Fashion Queen is in Hollywood - Katy (8 pages) [page 8 of the Katy Keene feature is a Katy Keene Paper Doll with outfits]

February 1950

Snap Happy - Suzie (8 pages) - Ferdie attempts to take Suzie's picture with a new camera he borrowed from his Uncle Blunderbuss.

Ferdie the Fall Guy - Suzie (6 pages) - Ferdie helps Suzie out by keeping Angel Puss busy, not realizing Suzie already had a beach date with someone else.

Hat's All, Brother - Suzie (6 pages) - Suzie goes hat shopping.

Father Not Wanted - Ginger (6 pages) - Ginger's party is a flop without her father around to entertain her friends.

Blow Me Down - Suzie (6 pages) - Ferdie and Greg compete in a trick shot bowling contest.

The Fashion Queen - Katy (6 pages) - Sis tricks Katy into thinking she's fat.

Katy Keene 1950 Pin-Up Calendar (1 page)

August 1950

Part (The Cover Art) of this issue is reprinted in World of Archie Double Digest #45 and Suzie Comics Special Digital edition.

October 1951

Professor Doodle's Doodles - Suzie (6 pages) - Professor Doodle demonstrates some of his latest inventions.

Tux Free - Suzie (8 pages) - Ferdie borrows a magician friend's tuxedo for a date with Suzie.

Hare Today Gone Tomorrow - Suzie (8 pages) - Ferdie tries out his ventriloquist act on Suzie's dad.

Say the Word - Suzie (1 page) - Suzie buys a $40 hat.

Doing What Comes Unnaturally - Ginger (6 pages) - Ginger's cheap, miserly, money-loving Uncle Scragg visits.

The Story Writer - Suzie (6 pages) - Suzie and Ferdie attempt to write a short story to win $500.

Angel with an Angle - Suzie (2 pages) - Suzie's niece acts like an angel.

Safety First - Suzie (5 pages) - Suzie is learning to drive.

Feb 1952

Throne For A Loss (6 pages) - Suzie wants Ferdie to babysit Angela so she can enter a roller skating competition with Gregory. Angela suggests that she and Ferdie go enter the competition on their own.

A Kick In The Plans (5 pages) - Suzie's father is on vacation and determined not to do anything during that vacation. However, that means Suzie has to do all of the household chores.

Information Please (1 page) - Angela peppers Suzie with questions about life.

White In The Night (1 page) - Ferdie learns the hard way why it's a good idea to wear white when walking at night.

Take It Easel (5 pages) - Ginger convinces her father to take up painting as a hobby, with disastrous results.

Out Of Sorts (1 page) - Suzie helps her friend sort strawberries over the phone.

Nurse To You (6 pages) - Ferdie goes to visit Suzie at her new job as a nursing attendant at the local hospital. There he slips on a wet floor and finds being a patient at this hospital can make you sick.

A Miss In The Dark (1 page) - Suzie and Ferdie take a Tunnel Of Love ride, but someone else ends up kissing Suzie.

A Long Dog Tale (6.5 pages) - Katy thinks Randolph is entertaining a beautiful French model.

Off Day (6 pages) - Suzie's father's day off is anything but restful.

December 1952
